rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=7, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 dual_domain_bilateral_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-3 img_n_bf=7/img_kernel5/ep10 hr=0.2466). (1) PRIOR: BF-depth saturated (7 BFs = 0.2466); epochs is NOT a lever (iter-4 ep30 = 0.2462, flat) -> the 6-24-param BF fit converges by ep10. OLD-split TPE best used img_kernel=7. (2) Failure mode: the 5x5 image BF footprint is too small to span sparse-view streak spacing; deeper stacks help only marginally because each filter is spatially narrow. (3) ONE KNOB: img_kernel 5 -> 7 (img_n_bf=7 held; epochs reverted 30->10 since ep30 wasted budget with no gain; lr/lambda_neg unchanged). (4) HYPOTHESIS: a 7x7 image BF kernel enlarges each filters spatial footprint and lifts hr above 0.2466 toward ~0.26-0.28, matching the TPE-favored img_kernel=7. If flat/down, spatial footprint is not the lever and iter-6 pivots to lr. (5) BUDGET: 7x7 vs 5x5 BF ~2x per-filter cost but still cheap; ep10 -> ~120s, well inside 20 min. (6) Loop continues. Artifacts saved.
